name: TTP-PLATFORM-ACCOUNT-MUTATION
ttps: Online-platform warning characteristics include frequent changes to an account name, contact details, or salary-payment information; an account-holder/payee-name mismatch; and self-posted false reviews intended to improve the account's rating.
caveats: Preserves platform-account mutation and self-review signals that were compressed or absent in earlier normalization.
The alert calls for combined characteristics; nationality, identity, and DPRK affiliation require multi-signal assessment.
